name: EquiFit New Original Open Front Boot - Black , Large
description: The EquiFit New Original Open Front Boot makes EquiFits first boot design even better! This horse boot has an anatomically-molded EverLeather and EVA shell and provides a sleek, secure, protective fit. The EverLeather shell is shaped to allow for a streamlined, ergonomic fit to provide enhanced protection to the horses leg. Upgraded elastic straps offer increased stretch, and three hook-and-loop closures allow for a truly custom fit. Like EquiFit's original T-Foam, the new E-Foam liner is designed to absorb impact, disperse pressure points and minimize rubs, all while keeping the leg cool. A revolutionary foam that firms to a protective shield on impact, E-Foam doesnt skimp on benefits: its breathable, antimicrobial, easy to wash and quick to dry. Liners are removable. Velcro closures. Pair.USA.
